response.overview: Set in rural Tamil Nadu in 2002, a young boy named Dileep and his mother are forced to rebuild their lives after a devastating betrayal tears their family apart. As poverty and life's hardships push them to their limits, a mother's unwavering love and sacrifices become their only strength. A heartfelt tale of betrayal, survival, unconditional love and the untold struggles behind a mother's sacrifices.
response.tagline: Some sacrifices are never seen. Some love never ends.
response.title: Kaadhalin Kadaisi Pakkam (காதலின் கடைசிப் பக்கம்)
